name: LoopForge
description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
one_liner: A self-hosted control room where a team can chat with AI coding agents like employees, set up repeatable step-by-step processes for them, and require a human to sign off before anything ships.
buyer: A CTO or VP of Engineering at a mid-size company who has multiple engineers using AI coding agents informally and wants standardized, auditable workflows instead of ad-hoc chaos.
business_use_cases: An engineering org sets up a fixed 'bug fix SOP' so every bug ticket runs through the same agent steps and a human approval gate before merging.
A software consultancy runs client work through LoopForge so every delivered PR has a consistent, logged review trail they can show clients as proof of process.
A platform team uses it to let non-engineers submit feature requests via chat, with Main Bot handling the sandboxed implementation and routing it for approval.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid enterprise support, onboarding, and custom SOP design for companies adopting it
Sell a managed cloud version so companies don't need to run their own Docker infrastructure

steal_this: Package one polished, pre-built SOP (e.g. 'turn a Figma file into a working landing page') as a done-for-you LoopForge template and sell it to small agencies who want the structure without building it themselves.
